claims.summary: Separate optimizers own generator and discriminator parameters.
The discriminator fake loss consumes detached generated images, blocking that backward path into G.
The generator loss reuses non-detached fake images and only the generator optimizer steps afterward.
D can accumulate gradients during generator backward and they are cleared at the next discriminator phase; the artifact explains this, while framework autograd semantics remain inferred.
The source accumulates and prints discriminator and generator loss values, but the artifact does not represent the reporting output.
